Title: The Quagmire
Description: Born into the Greyrat family of Buena Village in the Fittoa Region of the Asura Kingdom with the memories of a past life, Rudeus trained his mana from infancy and became a prodigy of chantless (incantation-free) magic with a mana pool far beyond ordinary mages. His staples are a hardened, high-velocity Stone Cannon and Quagmire, the Water-and-Earth mud spell behind his epithet; he later receives the Demon Eye of Foresight from Kishirika Kishirisu. In battle: relentless ranged pressure and enormous mana, but a light frame and low poise - close the distance and he folds.
PassiveDescription: Chantless Casting (canon): Rudeus casts without incantations. Offensive startup is 45% shorter (x0.55) and spells cost 5% less mana. Big spells still show a clear charge or gesture, so skilled opponents can read them.

Title: The Dragon God
Description: The Dragon God, son of the First Dragon God. Orsted bears a curse that makes nearly every living being instinctively fear and hate him, and he is bound to a loop that sends him back roughly every two hundred years until he slays the Human God, Hitogami. He is the master of the Dragon God Style of the former Dragon God Urupen - Disturb Magic and the Saint Dragon Battle Aura among its techniques - and has mastered many of the world's fighting schools. Because his mana recovers extraordinarily slowly, he fights with calm, economical, near-manaless technique: immovable on defence, but every spell he spends is hard to get back.
PassiveDescription: Dragon God's Knowledge (gameplay original, inspired by his countless loops): a perfect dodge, successful Disturb Magic or clean interrupt grants a short efficiency buff. No permanent stat bonus. Canon handicap kept: his mana regenerates very slowly.
